description: Decision table separating same-chain PLP contacts from cross-subunit interface residues, and PS00105 outcome comparison across the ACCS family
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np

# ---------- Artifact 1: cofactor-contact vs cross-subunit decision table ----------
tbl = pd.DataFrame([
 # ref, ref residue, structural role, class, T04F3.1, verdict
 ("1B8G apple ACS","Y145","PLP re-face / phosphate region","same-chain cofactor contact","Y3171","identical"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","N202","PLP phosphate + 3-OH (NPxxPLG loop)","same-chain cofactor contact","N3227","identical"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","D230","salt bridge to pyridinium N1","same-chain cofactor contact","D3255","identical"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","I232","si-face packing","same-chain cofactor contact","V3257","conservative"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","Y233","PLP 3-hydroxyl / C4'","same-chain cofactor contact","F3258","conservative (loses OH)"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","S270","PLP phosphate","same-chain cofactor contact","S3291","identical"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","S272","PLP phosphate","same-chain cofactor contact","S3293","identical"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","K273","Schiff-base Lys, 1.33 A covalent","same-chain cofactor contact","K3294","identical"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","R281","PLP phosphate (Arg)","same-chain cofactor contact","K3302","conservative, charge kept"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","G119/A120/T121/N124","Gly-rich phosphate loop","same-chain cofactor contact","S3145/T3146/R3147/Y3150","divergent, alignment uncertain"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","R407","substrate alpha-carboxylate","same-chain substrate contact","R3427","identical"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","Q83*","partner subunit, 3.8 A from PLP","cross-subunit / dimer interface","P3111","divergent"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","Y85*","partner subunit, 7.6 A from PLP","cross-subunit / dimer interface","A3113","divergent"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","S301*","partner subunit, 5.9 A from PLP","cross-subunit / dimer interface","M3322","divergent"),
 ("1B8G apple ACS","F302*","partner subunit, 7.7 A from PLP","cross-subunit / dimer interface","Y3323","conservative"),
 ("1ASM E. coli AspAT","Y70*","partner subunit, 2.6 A from PLP","cross-subunit / dimer interface","(not mapped, low id)","unresolved"),
 ("1ASM E. coli AspAT","R292*","partner subunit substrate specificity","cross-subunit / dimer interface","(not mapped, low id)","unresolved"),
], columns=["reference","ref_residue","structural_role","class","T04F3.1","verdict"])
tbl.to_csv("cofactor_vs_interface_decision_table.csv", index=False)
print(tbl.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- Artifact 2: PS00105 outcome table ----------
ps = pd.DataFrame([
 ("T04F3.1 G5EE32","NO","S3291 / S3293 / K3294 present; fails only at the Arg position, which is K3302","phosphate Arg -> Lys"),
 ("human ACCS Q96QU6","NO","A320 at the first phosphate-cup position; S322 / K323 / R331 all present","first [GS] position is Ala"),
 ("human ACCSL Q4AE70","NO","Q424 at the S270-equivalent; no residue aligned to S272 or to the Schiff-base Lys","Schiff-base lysine region lost"),
 ("apple ACS P37821","YES (pos 270)","SLSKDLGLPGFR, canonical","-"),
 ("tomato LE-ACS2 P18485","YES (pos 275)","SLSKDMGLPGFR, canonical","-"),
 ("E. coli AspAT P00509","YES (pos 243)","canonical","-"),
], columns=["protein","PS00105_match","basis","reason_for_failure"])
ps.to_csv("ps00105_outcome_table.csv", index=False)
print("\n", ps.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- Figure ----------
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14.5, 6), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.25,1]})

sub = tbl[tbl["class"].str.startswith(("same-chain","cross"))].copy()
colmap = {"identical":"#2a7f62","conservative":"#8ab27c","conservative (loses OH)":"#8ab27c",
          "conservative, charge kept":"#8ab27c","divergent":"#c4462f",
          "divergent, alignment uncertain":"#e0a33e","unresolved":"#9a9a9a"}
sub = sub.iloc[::-1].reset_index(drop=True)
y = np.arange(len(sub))
ax1.barh(y, 1, color=[colmap[v] for v in sub.verdict], edgecolor="white")
ax1.set_yticks(y)
ax1.set_yticklabels([f"{r}  ({c.split('/')[0].strip()})" for r,c in zip(sub.ref_residue, sub["class"])], fontsize=8)
for k,t in enumerate(sub["T04F3.1"]):
    ax1.text(0.5, k, t, ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold")
ax1.set_xticks([]); ax1.set_xlim(0,1)
ax1.axhline(len(sub)-11.5, color="black", lw=1.2, ls="--")
ax1.text(0.02, len(sub)-11.2, "cross-subunit interface residues", fontsize=8, style="italic", va="bottom")
ax1.text(0.02, len(sub)-11.8, "same-chain PLP / substrate contacts", fontsize=8, style="italic", va="top")
ax1.set_title("Experimentally observed contacts in apple ACC synthase (1B8G)\nand E. coli AspAT (1ASM), mapped onto T04F3.1", fontsize=10)

labels = ["T04F3.1\nG5EE32","human ACCS\nQ96QU6","human ACCSL\nQ4AE70","apple ACS\nP37821","tomato ACS\nP18485","E. coli AspAT\nP00509"]
schiff  = [1,1,0,1,1,1]; ser_cup = [2,1,0,2,2,2]; argphos = [0,1,0,1,1,1]; ps105 = [0,0,0,1,1,1]
x = np.arange(len(labels)); w=0.2
ax2.bar(x-1.5*w, schiff, w, label="Schiff-base Lys", color="#2a7f62")
ax2.bar(x-0.5*w, ser_cup, w, label="Ser of phosphate cup (0-2)", color="#5b9bd5")
ax2.bar(x+0.5*w, argphos, w, label="phosphate Arg", color="#e0a33e")
ax2.bar(x+1.5*w, ps105, w, label="PROSITE PS00105 match", color="#7a5195")
ax2.set_xticks(x); ax2.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8); ax2.set_ylim(0,2.4)
ax2.set_ylabel("residues present / pattern matched"); ax2.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)
ax2.set_title("PS00105 failure is not diagnostic of a dead site:\nT04F3.1 and human ACCS fail for different reasons", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nArtifacts written: cofactor_vs_interface_decision_table.csv, ps00105_outcome_table.csv")
